mapper.select: SELECT id, strategy_name_en AS strategyNameEn, from_date AS fromDate, to_date AS toDate, initial_cash AS initialCash, objective, validation_mode AS validationMode, target_monthly_return AS targetMonthlyReturn, target_is_guarantee AS targetIsGuarantee, status, message, created_at AS createdAt, updated_at AS updatedAt FROM quant_experiment_run WHERE id = #{id}
mapper.update: UPDATE quant_experiment_run SET status = #{status}, message = #{message}, updated_at = NOW() WHERE id = #{id}
mapper.select: SELECT id, run_id AS runId, variant_code AS variantCode, params, total_return AS totalReturn, annualized_return AS annualizedReturn, monthly_return AS monthlyReturn, mdd, sharpe_ratio AS sharpeRatio, turnover, total_cost AS totalCost, target_achieved AS targetAchieved, bias_check_status AS biasCheckStatus, overfit_score AS overfitScore, promoted, created_at AS createdAt FROM quant_experiment_variant WHERE run_id = #{runId} ORDER BY target_achieved DESC, overfit_score ASC, monthly_return DESC, id

SELECT id, run_id AS runId, variant_code AS variantCode, params, total_return AS totalReturn, annualized_return AS annualizedReturn, monthly_return AS monthlyReturn, mdd, sharpe_ratio AS sharpeRatio, turnover, total_cost AS totalCost, target_achieved AS targetAchieved, bias_check_status AS biasCheckStatus, overfit_score AS overfitScore, promoted, created_at AS createdAt FROM quant_experiment_variant WHERE run_id = #{runId} AND id = #{variantId}

SELECT w.id, w.variant_id AS variantId, w.window_no AS windowNo, w.train_from AS trainFrom, w.train_to AS trainTo, w.validation_from AS validationFrom, w.validation_to AS validationTo, w.test_from AS testFrom, w.test_to AS testTo, w.validation_monthly_return AS validationMonthlyReturn, w.test_monthly_return AS testMonthlyReturn, w.validation_mdd AS validationMdd, w.test_mdd AS testMdd, w.created_at AS createdAt FROM quant_experiment_window w JOIN quant_experiment_variant v ON v.id = w.variant_id WHERE v.run_id = #{runId} ORDER BY v.id, w.window_no
mapper.insert:
INSERT INTO quant_experiment_window ( variant_id, window_no, train_from, train_to, validation_from, validation_to, test_from, test_to, validation_monthly_return, test_monthly_return, validation_mdd, test_mdd ) VALUES
( #{item.variantId}, #{item.windowNo}, #{item.trainFrom}, #{item.trainTo}, #{item.validationFrom}, #{item.validationTo}, #{item.testFrom}, #{item.testTo}, #{item.validationMonthlyReturn}::numeric, #{item.testMonthlyReturn}::numeric, #{item.validationMdd}::numeric, #{item.testMdd}::numeric )
